name: Dysnamic
source:
Dysnamic is a story rich and character-focused visual novel with horror elements about a world with Dysnamia, an illness where symbols mark a person’s cheeks and they gain abilities with awful symptoms. From permanent gems impaling your skin after you grow gemstones, to great paranoia and negative emotions affecting you after you absorb the anger or sadness of others. Bene is a man with Dysnamia trying to help with Dalflown’s yearly festival, but as the week before the festival progresses, things increasingly go wrong, from accidents to disappearances, and Bene’s own conflicted mindset. He’s trying his best to manage his Dysnamia and help with the festival, trying to prevent everything from going wrong… but the world is not known to be kind to those with Dysnamia.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4123470/Dysnamic/]Steam[/url]]
